title: Note head, one line
summary: A reading page's head: the approved title at 72px (ONE line; the accent is one word, “window.”, so the number carries the title; round 8's added accent line “Where the deal is argued.” is cut (it repeated the standfirst)) → the 48×2 rule → one plain meta line (Narrative Systems · June 2026 · 2 min). No kicker, no byline (Q6), no facts box, no plate; the standfirst now opens the paper note.
story: The note's title and the three facts a reader wants (what it is about, when, how long) in one line; everything else is the note.
